vb_textbox.text: You always get the same 2 colours of gnomes paired together. Choose 1 of each to see which gives the most mushrooms. Keep choosing this one until the amount of mushrooms decreases. Then switch to find out which is now giving more mushroomsI also received advice that you should choose the gnomes that take you to the forest with the most mushrooms until the number of mushrooms decreases. then switch!Basically, if you are receiving 5 to 7 mushrooms, stick with this option until it decreases to 1 or 2. Then switch until you start seeing 5 - 7 again.good luck
